summary: UI tests (ProjectUITests) genuinely verify all 4 distinct states end-to-end, but the unit test's no-project segment (AppModelConversationTests.swift:376-379) is tautological: it asserts default field values on a freshly-constructed, never-refreshed DiffModel that is never instantiated in the real no-project path (RightPaneView shows its 'No Project' ComingSoonPane only when appModel.diffModel is nil, bypassing DiffModel entirely), so it cannot fail regardless of whether the actual no-project UI is broken.
